decision.rule: The adsb_rnn twelve-month leave-one-month-out goes ahead only if, for at least one variant, the 4-seed mean's recipe reading (all October rows) at its best w in 0.1..0.9 is at least 0.02% below the control (the selection bar of every round since adsb_v25). The declaration then fixes the variant(s), seeds and the candidate weights from these October readings alone. Otherwise the round stops with a recorded null.

design.rationale: October design (docs/adsb_rnn/design_report.json): the rnb 4-seed mean alone (113.85 s) already beats v25's residual pair on October's scope (114.29 s) and its seed curve is still falling (116.1 -> 113.85 from 1 to 4 seeds; an RMSE^2 = B + V/k fit puts 16 seeds within 0.2 s of the limit); the recipe reading rises from -0.059% at w 0.5 to -0.075% at w 0.9 (all rows); rwide blends better on the scope but overlaps the committee (same features) and reads -0.039%. Declared: rnb, 16 seeds (501-516), w in {0.5, 0.7, 0.9}.

development_scheme: Each declared network seed is fitted by tools/run_adsb_rnn.py on the residual stage's twelve-month leave-one-month-out (the eleven other 2025 months' in-scope rows, cross-fit v9, no held-out label read during training); per month the seed mean is the network column. tools/run_adsb_rnn_dev.py rebuilds v25 on the four recipe months with tools/run_adsb_nn2_dev.py's functions (the control must reproduce k32_m30_u25's recorded RMSE to 1e-9 s) and replaces only the residual (and, where declared, the committee-mix weight).

purpose: A neural-network member of the residual stage, the one component of the v25 recipe that has never had a network. The residual stage (label - cross-fit v9 on matched rows outside LIRF) is v25's mean of adj2 (month-weighted LightGBM) and cat (CatBoost); its hyper-parameters are exhausted (adsb_v26/v27), so a new model family is the remaining lever there.

variant_settings.note: the residual trees' 33 columns (feature set nb)

selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero; and its residual's pooled twelve-month scope RMSE is below the control's (the residual rounds' condition). Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v25.
ship: If a candidate is selected: every declared seed is refitted once on all twelve months' in-scope rows (same variant, epoch budget and seed) and predicts the ranking's in-scope rows; the seed mean replaces the network column. v25 is rebuilt from its recorded components and must reproduce the uploaded v25 exactly; only the residual (and a declared committee-mix weight) changes. Exported as the next version through the frozen submission contract, verified independently (every saved network reloaded and re-predicted), audited, and uploaded only with the user's approval. LIRF rows must equal the uploaded v25.
